sizeEstimate.threshold: extended = non-core types with summed synapse weight >=1200 (either direction) to core; core P1 = pC1 types with summed weight >=100 to pIP10/pMP2/pIP1 (9 of 52 pC1 types); edges kept at type-level weight>=50

openQuestions: P1 identity: male-cns has pC1_* types (dsx/fru coexpress), no type named P1; core = 9 pC1 types with >=100 weight to pIP10/pMP2/pIP1 (total 52 pC1 types, ~150 neurons). Map to P1a/P1b literature needed.
pIP10 and pMP2 each only 2 neurons (L/R). P1 -> pIP10 direct weight modest; main drive is pC1_14a -> pMP2 (962) -> dPR1 (1750).
TN1A = TN1a_a..i (9 subtypes, 2-4 neurons each); which subtypes are Shirangi TN1A vs others unclear. TN1c_* (not included) also fru+.

Wing MN NT predictions unreliable (unclear/histamine/GABA); all MNs assumed excitatory glutamatergic. hg/ps/b/i/iii/tp names are Lillvis/MANC style (hg1..4, ps1-2, b1-3, i1-2, iii1,3, tp1-2, tpn) plus MNwm35/36 (identity unresolved). iii2/iii4 not found.
DLM/DVM MNs included (DLMn a,b / c-f; DVMn 1a-c, 2a,b, 3a,b) - flight muscles also recruited for song; indirect-muscle role in song uncertain.
vMS11 (Glu) and vPR9 (GABA) inhibitory signs from NT prediction (conf ~.85); fine for sim but unverified against Lillvis 2024.
Extended tier (1545 neurons, 1200 threshold) is dominated by VNC leg/wing INs and brain pIP10/pMP2 inputs (aIPg7, ICL008m, AVLP7xxm); no auditory sensor included (JO-EV2->pIP1 1350 exists if needed).
No song-specific sensory input in scenario: song is initiated by stimulating P1/pC1 directly.
DNp62 NT unclear; DNp13 (dsx_high) included as extra fru/dsx DN, role in song unverified.
